_comment: The fields this page reads to know whether Patchwell's own Slack app is live. Patchwell's Slack app (created in the tictapp demo workspace) is connected to the demo-slack tenant and answers @-mentions in-thread — proven live 2026-09-13, see img/slack-proof.jpg. channelUrl opens the demo workspace channel where the bot lives; a real customer would point this at their own workspace. Set channelUrl null to return to the honest preview state.
